title: V gostilni · At the inn
setting: Friday evening at a traditional gostilna in the Vipava valley. You sit down with your partner, and the waiter comes to your table.
role: Natakar Marko, the waiter. Friendly, a bit fast, happy to recommend the house dishes. Says vi to guests.
opener_sl: Dober večer! Izvolite jedilni list. Kaj boste pili?
opener_en: Good evening! Here is the menu. What would you like to drink?
